about: Distance bounds from the runs of 6 November 2026 on the UMD cluster Zaratan and on a laptop, assembled by zaratan_certificates/assemble.py from the run records copied into evidence/. Each record is one tool's lower bound for one circuit, bound to it by the SHA-256 of its columns as compact JSON (master_catalog/constructions.digest). witnesses are the harmful faults the runs returned, each re-checked here with faultcore.Circuit.harmful and by the XOR of the wire masks. The lower bounds are the tools' and are not re-derived by verify_catalog.py; every fault is.

tools.mitm.c kernel: the meet-in-the-middle kernel research/plan/mitm/mitm.c (copied as evidence/laptop/mitm.c), which sweeps every fault of one weight, optionally in slices
tools.tropidist search: tropidist (B. Cheng, N. Guo and F. Pan, arXiv:2611.08247; github.com/Fanerst/tropidist at b03ec2d4, built with OpenMP) called at one threshold by research/plan/tdirect.py (copied as evidence/laptop/tdirect.py)
tools.tropidist pipeline: tropidist's benchmark pipeline, config dp=2 with a larger table budget, through research/zaratan/zaratan/dp_run.py, at commit b03ec2d4
